systems.title: Pets, Evolution & Consumable Effects
systems.statusDetail: Historic evolution at Pet level 15 costs 50,000 Bones, 500 Scrap and 75 Rune Dust; 17 paths passed code verifiers, not current all-path device QA. Kennel historical L1 3h/+30 XP, L2 3h/+45, L3 6h/+100. XP Surge is +25% on one next qualifying mission, not timed. Scent Trail affects mission loot; Ice Crystal is a Forge catalyst.
systems.summary: Adopt and activate companions, grow their levels and use them alongside your character. Evolution and consumable contracts have precise historical rules with current runtime gates.
systems.publicLimit: Alpha Spirit spirit_guard has no verified battle hook; Alpha Lord remains locked. Phantom Echo is not an open market. Exact live Pet catalog, evolution, Kennel and passive execution still need QA.
